tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Page ground of sites, docs and the app library. Carries the grid pattern.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tables, cards, menus and the VM row: anything that sits on grid.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The 16px protocol grid drawn over grid. Never a border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and around surfaces. Decorative only, below 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons and inputs; at least 3:1 on grid and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the variable- and fixed-length bars of the mark, on grid and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table metadata, on grid and surface-raised.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: The equivalence bar of the mark, links, primary buttons, focus. Text on grid and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-trace
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a trace fill.

tokens.name: trace-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the highlighted line in a diff or trace.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Status text for PASS and ACCEPTED, on pass-tint, grid and surface-raised. Always with the word.

tokens.name: pass-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind PASS and ACCEPTED status.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Status text for FAIL and guest errors, on fail-tint, grid and surface-raised. Always with the word.

tokens.name: fail-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind FAIL status and error rows.

tokens.name: wip
tokens.usage: Status text for IN PROGRESS, PARTIAL and EARLY WORK, on wip-tint, grid and surface-raised.

tokens.name: wip-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind in-progress statuses.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring in trace with a 2px offset, on every surface.

families.mono: "Spline Sans Mono", "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: site hero, release title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: CPU semantics are validated against physical x86 machines.
styles.usage: Running text on the site and in docs. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Measured on M3 Pro, median of 12 runs.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Native macOS app text. The app uses the system face; Literata appears only in the About window and the welcome screen.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: VM names, button labels in the app.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status words and eyebrows, always set in capitals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, paths, crate names, register dumps.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and measurements; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a status glyph and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between inline items; vertical padding of table cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: VM row inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: One grid cell. Card padding, table cell padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Cell size of the protocol grid pattern. Layout snaps to it.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables and full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Status badges and inputs. The mark keeps its own corner radius, 1/48 of its height.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, the VM row.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: macOS app icon body. Use only for the icon.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Everything else is separated by line, not shadow.
